contradicting_evidence: BTC and ETH depth snapshots are substantially ask-heavy despite positive taker buying; these transient snapshots leave continuation vulnerable but do not establish durable resistance.
The latest settled ETF session recorded BTC outflows of $244.1 million and ETH outflows of $72.5 million.
BTC rose while hourly open interest fell 0.67%, so the price advance does not demonstrate sustained new positioning or durable demand.
ETH underperformed BTC over 24h, and only 29.4% of the large-alt proxy outperformed BTC.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A tentative bid-led extension is somewhat better supported than an immediate synchronized decline. Expect uneven progress rather than a clean breakout: BTC and ETH may extend their latest hourly gains while selected mid/small proxy constituents participate. Retests remain credible, and the evidence does not establish recovery or sustained continuation.
falsification_conditions: A sustained reversal of the latest BTC and ETH hourly gains, accompanied by weaker spot taker buying and fading proxy breadth, would invalidate the upward lean.
Repeated ask-heavy depth alongside stalled prices and continued buying would weaken the extension case; buying against displayed supply alone is not proof of recovery.
Loss of mid/small proxy participation together with renewed ETH/BTC weakness would invalidate the participation component of the expected path.
missing_evidence: Repeated spot-flow and order-book observations to distinguish persistent buying from a brief burst.
Subsequent completed candles and open-interest observations confirming that the latest hourly advance holds.
Independent breadth confirmation and sustained ETH/BTC improvement.
supporting_evidence: The latest completed hour shows BTC up approximately 0.215% and ETH up 0.229%, with spot taker-buy quote shares of 68.1% and 61.0%, respectively.
Current Top-100 proxy breadth shows 67 advancers versus 31 decliners and a positive median 24h return of 0.577%.
Mid and small-alt proxies show positive median returns and advance ratios of 66.7% and 73.2%; participation is not limited to isolated winners.
The microstructure trade samples also show positive taker imbalances for BTC and ETH, consistent with the latest hourly buying evidence.
